title: A Pawn Takes the Queen
setup: Black's queen has parked on e4, one pawn step from your d3-pawn and guarded only by the pawn on f5.
hint: Count the defenders of the black queen, then look down the f-file before you decide it is safe there.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{dxe4}} takes the queen with a pawn. Recapturing with the f-pawn is illegal, because your rook on **f2** pins it to the king on **f7** along the open f-file. A pinned pawn cannot be anybody's bodyguard.
